name: nifty50-terminal
description: TradingView-style live Nifty 50 charting terminal (React + lightweight-charts + Node)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: node scripts/check-structure.mjs && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:render: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
